translations.adaptations: Preserve original arithmetic, score scaling, comparisons, diagonal bounds, longest-run ties, X-drop criteria and traceback operation order. Owned scratch/pool buffers replace C allocation/free. Explicit slices and nullable mutable output references replace sequence and output pointers. Normal Rust allocation failure behavior applies; valid original score/length domains are asserted. Ring-row reuse and all-distance traceback rows retain original behavior and pool geometry. Biasing C pointers becomes private bounds-checked row views backed by stable Vec buffers; wrapping_offset forms biased addresses without out-of-allocation pointer arithmetic, and dereferences occur only after range checks. The original padded score/bound arrays use explicit prefix offsets. No generic DP substitution or approximate traceback is introduced. A negative-size affine empty-row allocation is represented by an empty row instead of forming a biased null pointer. When gap_open and gap_extend are zero, the affine entry point retains the original distance return from BLAST_GreedyAlign rather than converting it to a score.

integration_notes: Add pub mod greedy_align to core/mod.rs. No existing shared file edits were made by this worker.

Scratch APIs use scoped GreedyScoringParameters and GreedyExtensionParameters containing only fields consumed by s_BlastGreedyAlignMemAlloc. Parent can lower existing scoring/extension objects into these structs.

SGreedyAlignMem owns stable scratch buffers and original-sized linked pool blocks. Private biased row views use bounds checks; no public arbitrary row pointers are accepted by alignment/traceback helpers. An unsafe Send impl is justified by exclusive ownership of stable allocations and mutable scratch access.
s_GetMBSpace returns a raw allocation pointer, as upstream; pool fields are private. Rust-only row field bindings and owned-memory Drop are not additional translated upstream functions.

Temporary focused artifacts: /tmp/btyper-greedy-oracle.c, /tmp/btyper-greedy-reference.txt, /tmp/btyper-greedy-check.rs, /tmp/btyper-greedy-check and /tmp/btyper-greedy-check-opt. Both debug and optimized wrappers pass 480 cases.

Full gapped extension orchestration (BlastGreedyGappedAlignment in blast_gapalign.c), combining left/right edit blocks, result/HSP filtering and final BLAST search parity remain outside this worker scope.
